narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia.
ev: Nearly one foot of water covered Conduit Road near Colonial Heights High School.
National Weather Service employee reported 2.5 feet of water on eastbound of Temple Avenue.
Bridge was under water along the 4800 Block of Heritage Road.
Flash flooding was reported on Merchants Hope Road.
Water breached some shallow ditches and started covering sections of Beach Road and Riverway Road near Winterpock.
High water was on River Road.
Route 635 was closed at James River Drive due to water on road.
Water was covering River Road (Route 602) at Second Branch Road.
Bank and Bollingbrook Streets were closed at Crater Road due to water over road. There were numerous reports of 3 to 4 inches of rainfall in this area over the past 90 minutes.
Route 664 was closed due to high water.
